items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Not only Louis, but you could hear lot of this same things among, with Joe Oliver, Red Allen, Bob Scheffner, they all had something in common.

ctx.x: Joking, wonderful jokes, you know. He was just an ordinary -- extraordinary man. And I don't think anybody ever will be able to play like him. I didn't have any idea of ever playing like him, but I wanted to get in there and see what was inside of it, you know. Not only Louis, but you could hear lot of this same things among, with Joe Oliver, Red Allen, Bob Scheffner, they all had something in common.
Well I was wondering because you inherited that band all of a sudden, you found yourself being a band leader at the Dreamland, and you really -- you -- most of your career, you've been a side man --
